summary: Wellchange Holdings Co Ltd filed Form 6-K attaching notice of shareholder meetings and proxy statement for its class A, class B, and annual general meeting. The sole proposed resolution is to increase class B voting rights from 35 to 100 votes per share and adopt amended articles. There is no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special-situation event. The filing is a routine proxy solicitation for a charter amendment. The board recommends voting FOR. No deal terms or financial figures are present. This is an ordinary governance matter, not a special situation.
